title: Desert Serpent Weeping
description: A surreal desert scene features a large golden serpent with ornate patterns forming an arch, entwined with purple flowering vines. Below it, a giant green crying head with closed eyes spills multicolored tears into puddles, while a red rodent wizard in a brown cloak holds a staff and looks up. Two silhouetted figures, one purple and one black with horns, stand in the background amid cacti, roses, and sand dunes under a large full moon.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at night with a massive golden ornate serpent arching across the scene, wrapped in purple flowering vines and dripping water. A giant green female head with closed eyes emerges from the cracked ground, crying long streams of multicolored tears that form puddles. In the foreground a red anthropomorphic rodent wizard wearing a brown cloak holds a glowing staff. Two dark silhouetted figures, one purple and one with horns, stand behind the head. Cacti, desert roses, sand dunes and a large pale moon in a dark sky complete the mystical scene.
